label: Diagram 11.7
caption: Diagram 11.7 Permitted unprotected areas in small residential buildings
description: The drawing is a plan view accompanied by a table, titled in a green banner at the bottom "Diagram 11.7 Permitted unprotected areas in small residential buildings". In the top left corner is the text "See para 11.18". The plan shows a building outline drawn with a double line, forming a rectangle with a stepped cut on its lower edge. A green double-headed arrow spans the width of the upper part of the plan and is labelled "24m max.". A green dimension line marked "a" runs from the lower left edge of the plan down to a dashed line labelled "Relevant boundary". To the right, a two-column table reads, in its headers, "Minimum distance (a) between side of building and relevant boundary (m)" and "Maximum total area of unprotected areas (m²)". The rows pair the figures 1 with 5.6, 2 with 12, 3 with 18, 4 with 24, 5 with 30, and 6 with "No limit".
